name: Great Lakes Gas Transmission System Wide Expansion
researcher_notes: New row in expansion shape. Not an existing row: P0194 is the 1967 system row with no segment name and no expansion rows. A FERC environmental assessment notice of 21 Aug 1997 (docket CP96-647) describes the 1998 Expansion Project as three 36 inch loops totaling about 71.5 miles: Loop 1 22.0 mi in Kittson County MN, Loop 2 26.7 mi in Clearwater, Beltrami and Hubbard counties MN, Loop 3 22.8 mi in Carlton County MN and Douglas County WI. So the new pipe is confirmed and is real looping, not compression only. The EIA August 2026 release (sheet Historical Projects 1996-2024, Excel row 87, 'GLT System Wide Expansion') lists 72 mi, 36 in, +126 MMcf/d, completed Nov 1998, CP96-647. EIA and the FERC notice are separate origins. Capacity stored as note only: +126 MMcf/d incremental (EIA); not put in Capacity because the cell is total capacity for a row. Owner shown is the current P0194 owner spelling; the 1998 sponsor was Great Lakes Gas Transmission Limited Partnership. Start and end are loop locations along the line, not a continuous route. No route found: RouteAccuracy no route, route to be researched. Completion in service is by EIA only, tier high for length and diameter, medium for the in service year. Length 71.5 mi is over the 15.5 mi threshold.
